ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 (MIT), unmodified upstream files from the onnxruntime-web npm package.
ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs and .jsep.wasm are the upstream non-JSEP ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs / .wasm stored under the file names ort.min.js requests (CPU/WASM backend only, no WebGPU). SHA-256 values are in ../SHA256SUMS.
